<thought>The base peak at m/z 199.0 likely corresponds to [M+H]+, giving a neutral mass of ~197.99 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a very strong M+2 peak, characteristic of a sulfur atom (34S). A formula that matches the exact mass and isotopic pattern is C9H10O3S.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O3S</final_answer>
